title: Readiness Leakage Scorecard — Framework v1 Baseline vs. v2 Target
authority: SESSION350_V1_BASELINE.json (Board A); SESSION203_READINESS_ENGINE_SPEC.json; SESSION321_READINESS_ENGINE_SPEC.json; scripts/output/readiness_scoring.json (S322 operational snapshot)
purpose: Measure readiness leakage — the rate at which structurally defective items reach certification. Framework v1 leaked at 89.5%. Framework v2 targets <10% via pre-flight gating that hides REMEDIATE and BLOCKED items from Quality and Certification boards.

BLOCKED.label: BLOCKED — Structurally Impaired
BLOCKED.description: Item has identity, JSON integrity, or severe structural defects. Cannot enter any review pipeline.
BLOCKED.board_visibility: Governance Board only — invisible to Quality and Certification boards
BLOCKED.resolution: Manual repair → re-enter pipeline. Route to EditorialQueue with BLOCK_REASON.

REMEDIATE.label: REMEDIATE — Remediation Required
REMEDIATE.description: Item has structural/content defects that block certification but are automatically receivable.
REMEDIATE.board_visibility: Governance Board only — invisible to Quality and Certification boards
REMEDIATE.resolution: Authorized remediation script or editorial session → re-enter Gate 1

MINOR_FIX.label: MINOR_FIX — Minor Fixes Recommended
MINOR_FIX.description: Content-quality issues that don't affect answer correctness or learner safety.
MINOR_FIX.board_visibility: Quality Board (with warning badges), Certification Board (with DEFERRED flag)
MINOR_FIX.resolution: Can be certified WITH WARNINGS. Warnings must be acknowledged by Certification Board.

READY.label: READY — Ready for Certification
READY.description: All pre-flight gates PASS. Eligible for Quality Board and Certification Board review.
triggers: All gates PASS — no HARD_FAIL, no SOFT_FAIL, no WARN
READY.board_visibility: Quality Board and Certification Board — full detail
READY.resolution: Immediately eligible for CAQS §1.6 six-dimension verification.

CERTIFY.label: CERTIFY — Certified for Learner Pool
CERTIFY.description: Quality Board + Certification Board approved. question_state = 'Certified'.
CERTIFY.resolution: Item available for learner practice sessions.

readiness_score_algorithm.description: Per-item 0-100 numeric score from gate results. Used for session prioritization.

tier_mapping.70-89: YELLOW — Ready with warnings; minor fixes recommended

readiness_leakage_definition.description: Readiness leakage is the rate at which items reach certification (question_state='Certified') with undetected defects that should have been caught by pre-flight gating. Leakage is measured post-certification by retrospective scan — if a currently Certified item would fail a pre-flight gate if re-scanned today, it leaked.

leakage_categories.structural_leakage: Certified item has DL-008, DL-026, DL-016, or DL-021 — structural defects that Gate 1 should have caught
leakage_categories.identity_leakage: Certified item has identity ambiguity — Gate -1 should have caught
leakage_categories.content_leakage: Certified item has DL-013 boilerplate or EV3 citation gap — Gate 2 should have flagged
leakage_categories.answer_key_leakage: Certified item has wrong CorrectChoice — Gate 4 should have caught (most severe leakage)

readiness_leakage_definition.measurement_frequency: Every session at T0 by re-running Gates -1 through 4 against all Certified items. Any newly detected defects in the Certified pool = leakage event.

v1_baseline.label: Framework v1 Readiness Leakage — Historical Baseline

evidence.domain_e_seeds: 34 of 38 Domain E seeds arrived at certification with 2+ concurrent defects (S200)
evidence.zero_scanned: 38 of 38 seeds had zero pre-certification automated scanning
evidence.leakage_events: 43 leakage events documented across 14 certification waves (S201 Board 2)
evidence.preventable_pct: 91.5% of leakage events classified as preventable via pre-flight gating
root_causes: No pre-certification automated structural scan existed
ExplanationValidator had line-173/180 gaps that silently skipped DL-008/DL-026/DL-013
Governance guard Rule 2 BLOCK was activated AFTER thousands of items were already Certified
QID-only identity model caused wrong-target remediation
No board visibility rules — defective items appeared in Certification Board review queues

defect_prevalence_in_certified_pool.dl008_peak: 539 occurrences historically — resolved to 0 via S722A/S802/S726 verification
defect_prevalence_in_certified_pool.dl021_active: 95 Certified items in Pack E Section C with absent distractor EW slots
defect_prevalence_in_certified_pool.dl016_active: 58 Pack A Section E Certified items with metadata offset — EW describes wrong item
defect_prevalence_in_certified_pool.dl013_peak: 2,587 fields historically — reduced via certification waves
defect_prevalence_in_certified_pool.dl030_historical: 5 answer-key errors found in Certified pool (all resolved Phase 0B)

v2_target.label: Framework v2 Readiness Leakage Target
enablers: Gate -1 through Gate 4 pre-flight pipeline — 7 gates catch defects before any human review
Board visibility rules — REMEDIATE and BLOCKED items invisible to Quality and Certification boards
Mandatory pre-flight at every session T0 — no item enters review without current scan
Compound-key identity — eliminates wrong-target remediation (S320-class failures)
Governance guard Rules 6-10 — HARD_BLOCK enforcement on un-scanned items

phase_gates.S830: <44.7% (≥50% improvement from v1 baseline). HARD_BLOCK if not met.
phase_gates.S900: <10% (full v2 target). HARD_BLOCK if not met.

v2_target.measurement_method: Re-run full Gate -1 through Gate 4 scan against all Certified items at session T0. Count items that would fail a gate today ÷ total Certified items.

current_operational_snapshot_s322.label: S322 Readiness Scoring — Live Operational Data
current_operational_snapshot_s322.analysis: Framework v1 readiness at S322: 87.44% overall. Domains B, C, D fully ready. Domain A nearly ready (99.47%). Domains E and F are the primary readiness drag (59.8% and 60.2% respectively) — these are the uncertified sections with structural defects (DL-008, DL-026, DL-013) holding items in BLOCKED and REMEDIATE states.

leakage_tracking_protocol.description: How readiness leakage is measured at each session checkpoint

T0_check.action: Re-run pre-flight Gates -1 through 4 against all items with question_state='Certified'
T0_check.pass_condition: Zero newly detected HARD_FAIL or HARD_BLOCK conditions on Certified items
T0_check.response_to_failure: Any Certified item that fails a gate is immediately flagged as a leakage event. Severity CRITICAL if DL-030 or DL-008. Logged in GOVERNANCE_REPORT and DEFECT_LIBRARY.md.
T0_check.metric: Number of leakage events detected at T0

Tmid_check.action: Re-run Gate 1 (structural) against items currently under review
Tmid_check.pass_condition: No items transitioning toward certification have undetected structural defects
Tmid_check.response_to_failure: Halt certification actions on affected items. Route to REMEDIATE.

Tend_check.action: Re-run full pre-flight on all newly Certified items
Tend_check.pass_condition: Zero leakage events on newly Certified items
Tend_check.response_to_failure: Immediate governance escalation. Newly Certified items with defects are reverted to REMEDIATE.
